svg.text: Recovery Workbench · build calendar, November 2026 to June 2027
19 microservices in 6 clusters. One bar = one work package = one service for one monthly release. Work packages talk only through published contracts, so any stream can pick up any cluster or month.

text.tspan: RWB = Recovery Workbench · SVC = service epic · P1 = module 1 (rwb-source-data)
platform modules: shared capabilities used by every stage (data, case, access, documents...)
stage modules: one recovery stage each (valuation, treatment, guarantee, litigation...)
platform epics: TPL template, LIB libraries, WF workflow kit, DB, EVT events, EDGE, OBS
integration epics per wave, plus ITG-NFR (load, resilience)
story: module P1 · legacy key RWB-E1-064 · work type
work types: CON contract · DB · INF infra · OPS · APP code · ITG integration test
Each module = 1 service: own schema rwb_<name>, REST base, Kafka topic, Temporal queue

svg.text: Adding a stream later (for example in January for February and March)
1. Hand over whole bars only: a service for a month, never part of one.
2. Take a cluster (C1 to C6) or one month column of a cluster; both are self-contained.
3. Each service's contract is published with a fake before its build (gate G7),
so the new stream builds against fakes and waits for no one.
4. Separate code, schema, topic and queue per service: no merge conflicts across streams.
5. Start on the Monday its build window opens; SIT and UAT stay on the shared release train.
Example: a stream joining mid-January takes C5 (S2, S5, S4) for February and March.
RWB-TE-001 module folder + boundary test → PLT-TPL
RWB-E1-001 recovery tables (Dev In Progress) → P1, P4, P7, P8
RWB-TE-003 contract tests from the API spec → PLT-TPL
28 Feb · Settle, deed in lieu, assets
Finish TPL, LIB, WF, DB, EVT, EDGE, OBS
Full administration (behind a flag until the June release)

Sources: Jira export (November sprint status), Realignment Tracker v4 (story split), Ownership Map v1 (19 services), Release Plan v5 (scope and month-end dates, tentative). Build is continuous; SIT and UAT take the last two weeks of each month. Decision D-RCV-60.
